caption: Pancake batter is poured onto a hot griddle, and the pale liquid sets from the edge inward while small bubbles rise through its top.

sa.check: Pancake batter is poured onto a hot griddle.
The batter spreads into a round.
The batter sets from its edge inward.
Small bubbles rise and burst on its upper side.
The pour comes first and the setting follows.

pc.expect: The setting only advances inward from the edge and the set part does not turn back to liquid.
pc.fail: A set part turns back to glossy liquid on the hot griddle; or the setting spreads and then retreats; or the batter sets from its centre outward to the edge; or the batter sets and softens in turn.

pc.expect: The batter arrives as a thick liquid that spreads and levels and becomes a soft solid that holds its shape and can be lifted.
pc.fail: The batter runs as thin as water over the griddle; or the batter stays a glossy liquid while being lifted whole; or the set pancake shatters; or the batter stands as a rigid dome as it is poured.

pc.expect: The batter spreads outward and downhill over the griddle and the bubbles rise to its upper surface and burst there.
pc.fail: The batter climbs the griddle's raised edge and stays; or the bubbles sink through the batter to the griddle; or a bubble rises off the pancake and floats; or the batter runs uphill.

pc.expect: The batter sets where it touches the hot metal first: its underside and rim firm up while the middle is still wet.
pc.fail: The middle of the top sets while the rim is still liquid; or the pancake's underside stays wet and glossy while its top has set; or the batter sits on the griddle and stays fully liquid to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: One pour makes one pancake; the batter stays on the griddle and nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A second pancake appears with nothing poured; or the pancake vanishes; or batter passes through the griddle; or the pancake grows with no batter added.

pc.expect: The griddle, the jug and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The griddle changes colour; or the jug changes shape; or items around the griddle rearrange.

note: The underside browning as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged.
